literal_meaning: বুননের ছাঁদনের দড়ি বাহুর লতায় (loom rope in the creepers of arms)
figurative_meaning_en: A firm embrace; encirclement with arms
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা ছাঁদনদড়ি বাহুলতায় একে অপরকে জড়িয়ে ধরল।
example_sentences_in_english: They held each other in a bear hug like chhandon dori bahulata.
The reunion was marked by a firm embrace akin to chhandon dori bahulata.
note: Refers to the tight binding of loom ropes, metaphorically extended to strong physical affection in Bengali rural traditions.
